get.description: Liveness/readiness for probes and proxies; public even when auth is enabled. Degraded when projects cannot be written.

Response Create Project Api Projects Post

put.description: Editor save: changes become overrides on the model's interpretation, then checks + rebuild.

post.description: Apply the user's answers (overrides; one without values removes that target's override).
Ask the model once more about the module's open questions (background; poll the module).

DrawingType.title: DrawingType
DrawingType.description: Type of document found in a furniture project package.

EdgeBanding.title: EdgeBanding
EdgeBanding.description: Edge banding (okleina) specification per panel edge.

HardwareItem.title: HardwareItem
HardwareItem.description: A fitting (okucie) of the module, from construction rules or detected in the drawing text.

ModuleModel.title: ModuleModel
ModuleModel.description:
A built module: interpretation, 3D solids, cut list, hardware, processes, and edit state.

``module`` = resolve(``draft``) with ``overrides`` applied on top; without a draft, ``overrides``
applied to ``base_module``. ``refine_*`` track the model re-run that fills open questions.

Override.title: Override
Override.description:
A user-provided value applied on top of the model's interpretation.

Targets: the Question ids plus ``cell:<cell_id>:front``, ``cell:<cell_id>:shelves`` and
``cell:<cell_id>:material``. Dimensions take ``mark_id`` (value read from that mark) or
``value_mm``; materials take an existing ``material_key`` or a new ``material`` legend entry.

Panel.title: Panel
Panel.description:
A single furniture panel (element płyty) in a cutting list.

Maps to one row in a CNC cutting optimization sheet.

ProcessLine.title: ProcessLine
ProcessLine.description: One production / mounting operation with its quantity and estimated time.

Question.title: Question
Question.description:
Data the drawing did not provide; answered by the user (Override) or a model re-run.

``id`` is the Override target it is answered with: ``width``, ``height``, ``depth``, ``plinth``,
``col:<index>:width``, ``cell:<cell_id>:height``, ``material:carcass``, ``material:front``.

TextRun.title: TextRun
TextRun.description: A text object of the PDF page with its normalized position.

UncertainItem.title: UncertainItem
UncertainItem.description: A value of the draft the model flags as unsure (column/row are 1-based, left→right, top→bottom).

ViewCheck.title: ViewCheck
ViewCheck.description: One dimension of the module compared against another view or another drawing of it.
